name: Rococo Co.Ltd.
summary: Rococo Co. Ltd. provides IT consulting solutions, including IT outsourcing that covers helpdesk support, kitting, managing PCs over their lifecycle, infrastructure and network configuration, and engineers resident at client sites. It also assists with digital transformation, offers business process outsourcing, and provides ticketing solutions as well as Re-tass LIVE, a one-to-one online streaming service. Dating from 1994, it has its headquarters in Osaka, Japan.
